name: Croissant
siboNotes: Contains wheat-based fructans that can trigger SIBO symptoms. Consider sourdough alternatives which may have reduced fructan content due to fermentation.
preparationTips: Choose smaller portions to stay within low FODMAP limits
Pair with low FODMAP proteins or fats to slow digestion
Toast lightly to improve texture without adding FODMAPs
Check ingredients for added garlic or onion powder
alternatives: Gluten-free pastries made with rice flour
nutritionalHighlights: Contains B vitamins from wheat flour
Source of dietary fat from butter
Iron and folate from enriched flour
